# Majestic carapace

Type: Material | Internal ID: QueenDrop | Source: The Queen | Usage: Building | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Majestic carapace is an item dropped by The Queen. It is required to build the Artisan press.

## Availability

Five are dropped by The Queen upon defeat, unaffected by the resource rate.

### Building

• Artisan press

## Trivia

• This item was named "Queen drop" and was a placeholder before the Ashlands update.

Categorias: Materials
